MEASURE: consolidated gross margin over four consecutive quarters while revenue growth stays above 15% YoY. FIRES IF gross margin remains at or below 20% through FY2027 on >15% revenue growth - advanced-packaging demand is passing through to the customer and the PEG-cheap reading is an artefact of earnings leverage on a near-zero base, not of value capture. FULL-YEAR HISTORY: FY2022 18.8%, FY2023 14.5%, FY2024 14.8%, FY2025 14.0% - the four-year peak is 18.8% and the threshold is set ABOVE it, so this falsifier fires unless margin structurally exceeds anything AMKR has achieved in four years. While revenue growth is 25.6% YoY (>15%), the margin remains low, indicating potential for demand to be passing through without significant value capture, aligning with the falsification signal's premise. The threshold is set above AMKR's historical peak, making it a challenging target.
